name: Bank of America
description: Bank of America is a bank and financial holding company that earns money two ways: the spread between what it pays on deposits ($2.02 trillion) and earns on loans ($1.19 trillion) (net interest income, $60.7B in 2025), and fees (noninterest income, $53.0B) from cards, wealth management, investment banking, trading and services. It reports four segments: Consumer Banking (branches, cards, small business), Global Wealth and Investment Management (Merrill and Private Bank), Global Banking (corporate and investment banking) and Global Markets (sales and trading). Consumer Banking is the largest by revenue and net income, with Global Banking second by net income; Global Markets is almost entirely fee and trading income. It returned about $21.4B of repurchases in 2025.

employees.note: Approximately 213,000 employees, of which 77 to 78 percent were in the US (10-K).

businessLines.name: Consumer Banking
businessLines.how: Takes deposits and lends to consumers and small businesses through about 3,600 financial centers, 15,000 ATMs and digital banking (about 49 million active users); earns the interest spread on deposits, cards, mortgages and auto loans plus card and service fees. 81 percent of revenue is net interest income (35,309 of 43,673, computed).

businessLines.name: Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM)
businessLines.how: Merrill and Private Bank clients pay asset-management fees on client assets (charged as a percentage, so they rise with market values and inflows), brokerage commissions and banking spread on deposits and loans; 71 percent of revenue is noninterest income (17,686 of 24,883, computed).

businessLines.name: Global Banking
businessLines.how: Lends to and holds deposits for corporations, earns treasury-services fees, and earns investment banking fees from advising on and underwriting deals (shared with Global Markets); net interest income 52 percent of revenue (12,611 of 24,108, computed), and net income fell 2.4 percent in 2025 (7,793 vs 7,984).

businessLines.name: Global Markets
businessLines.how: Makes markets and trades fixed income, currencies, commodities and equities for institutional clients, earning bid-offer spreads, trading gains, financing interest and underwriting fees; 76 percent of revenue is noninterest income (18,406 of 24,096, computed).

businessLines.name: All Other
businessLines.how: Residual items not allocated to segments (asset and liability management, equity investments, tax-equivalent adjustment elimination); not a business.

brands.name: Merrill (wealth and brokerage) and Bank of America Private Bank
brands.note: Part of GWIM; revenue $24,883M in 2025, 21 percent of segment-revenue total (computed)
